In [[3962 BBY]], [[Dorjander Kace]] and his [[Mandalorian Knights]] '''raided''' the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] made an effort to kidnap young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]].
